scope: Numeric requirements proposed by the primary-source technical facts audit

reviews.decision: The 1 GB value describes storage in the hosted Pro plan, not a self-hosting requirement.
The official minimum-system-requirements section gives 4 GB for the complete installation.
The hobby deployment instructions recommend at least 8 GB RAM. The recommended 64 GB disk value is not stored as a minimum.
The official quick start recommends at least 4 GB RAM for testing.
The RAM figures vary by model size and the 8 GB figure is stated only for macOS with a 3B model.
The 8 GB instruction applies to the development Minikube VM, not a general production minimum.
The official quick-start prerequisites state a 4 GB RAM minimum and 10 GB disk space.
The official prerequisites require at least 8 GB available memory and 150 GB available SSD storage.
The 12 GB recommendation applies to the development container, not the self-hosted app generally.
The 10 GB value applies to the optional advanced installation path, not the base app.
The official production guidance recommends at least 4 GB RAM.
